send_samples_to_streams: send samples to all active streams matching a given stream name via the Session websocket
add_stream_to_session: add an ApiStreamDesc to the Session so it receives sample messages for its stream name
remove_stream_from_session: remove an ApiStreamDesc from the Session and clean up its batch number tracking
get_streams_by_name: get all ApiStreamDesc objects registered in the Session that match a given stream name
check_stream_name_active: check whether a given stream name has any active streams registered in the Session
